topic: Planning with the energy of each month rather than against it: choosing one bold move for the Water Horse and one thing to hold, using the quarter's current rather than fighting it.
phrases: Plan with the current, not against it.
One bold move. One thing to hold.
The current is the whole point.
Know when to push. Know when to hold.
The prepared ones ride the Water Horse.

images.concept: A woman walking along a river path in the same direction as the current. Moving with the flow, not against it. Morning light, purposeful stride, something to carry forward.
images.prompt: A cinematic wide shot: a woman walking along a river path, moving in the same direction as the current beside her. She carries a journal under one arm. Her stride is purposeful and light. She is in motion, not hurrying, going with something rather than against it. Morning light hits the water beside her and the path ahead. Lush riverbanks. The mood is ease and forward purpose. Palette: soft sage green banks, antique gold morning light, warm ivory path. Women never face camera directly. No text in image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A map spread open on a table with two objects placed deliberately on it: a stone (hold) and a small lit candle (move). The two-action weekend challenge made visual.
images.prompt: A wide table composition: a paper map or journal spread is open, taking up most of the frame. Two objects are placed deliberately on it: a smooth river stone on one side (representing holding) and a small taper candle, lit, on the other (representing movement). The objects are separate, intentional, each sitting on a different area of the spread. Warm candlelight illuminates the right side; the left side is in softer ambient light. The mood is considered, two-part planning. Palette: warm ivory paper, antique gold candlelight, smooth grey stone, dark wood table. No text legible. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman wading in shallow river water, moving with the current, looking down at the water flowing around her feet. Full presence in the flow.
images.prompt: Square composition: a woman stands ankle-deep in a clear, shallow river, seen from behind. She is looking down at the water flowing around her feet, moving in the same direction as the current, not against it. The water is clear over smooth stones. Summer light. The mood is presence, ease, going with rather than against. Palette: cool water blues, warm ivory stone riverbed, soft sage green banks, antique gold summer light. Women never face camera directly. No text in image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: English affirmation card: the weekend challenge phrase as a daily reminder.
images.prompt: A square affirmation card, 1080x1080. Warm cream paper background with a soft aged texture. Subtle deckle edges on the top and right, a single faint tea-stain ring in the lower right corner, one folded corner top-left catching gentle shadow. The paper fills the frame edge-to-edge. Overhead natural morning light from the upper left. Rendered in the exact center of the paper, in hand-inked brush lettering, deep walnut ink, the phrase: "Plan with the current." Two lines, centered, the first line slightly larger than the second. The lettering is confident and elegant. Modern calligraphy, not cursive. Spell every word perfectly and space the letters clearly. One tiny hand-drawn ink flourish beneath the second line. Palette: warm cream, walnut brown ink, a single faint blush tea-stain. The overall feeling is intimate, like a page torn from a woman's journal. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
